entries.source:
Leave from Durheim Archives, Vasburg Armory or Unwaking Waters (Kurzick). Even though he appears to be alone, six Wardens of Seasons will popup when you get close to his initial location. However, as he has a larger-than-usual aggro bubble, you can pull him towards you without spawning those Wardens of Seasons.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.

從杜漢姆卷藏室、維思柏兵營或 Unwaking Waters（庫茲柯）出發。他雖看似獨自一人，但接近其初始位置時，會出現 6 名 Wardens of Seasons。不過，他的警戒範圍比一般敵人大，因此可以先將他引向隊伍，而不觸發這 6 名敵人出現。

entries.source:
The recommended way to reach Jedeh is to start from the Mouth of Torment. Take the western exit to the Ruptured Heart and make your way to the portal to Crystal Overlook. There will be a few mobs of Graven Monoliths, Margonites and Giants to defeat or avoid. Once you reach the Overlook, the most direct route to Jedeh is indicated by the blue line on the map. However, this will take you through several groups of Djinn, who can be tough to fight especially in Hard Mode. An alternative that is more time-consuming but less lethal is to turn left after entering the map, and board a Junundu. Go through the sulfurous area in the middle of the map and approach Jedeh from the east rather than the northeast. All the mobs you meet along the way should be small and easily disposed of.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
建議從 Mouth of Torment 出發，經西側出口進入破裂之心，再前往通往水晶高地的傳送門。沿路有幾群銘刻石雕、瑪骨奈與巨人，需要擊敗或避開。抵達水晶高地後，地圖藍線是前往 Jedeh 最直接的路線，但會穿過數群巨靈怪；尤其在困難模式下，戰鬥相當棘手。另一條路線較耗時，但危險較低：進入地圖後左轉，搭乘 Junundu，穿越地圖中央的硫磺區，從東側而非東北側接近 Jedeh。這條路線沿途的敵群規模較小，較容易消滅。

完成記錄歸屬接取任務時的輪換期，不會改變永久技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: less lethal 是危險較低，不是殺傷力較小；small mobs 指敵群規模，保留東與東北方向的區別。 完成記錄僅屬接取時輪換期，不變更永久技能與清圖記錄。

entries.source:
Justiciar Thommis is the left most boss on the map. 
The Stone Summit Warders should be the first target as they have protective wards and can deal massive area of effect damage.
The other main target should be Stone Summit Defenders because they have Power Drain and Waste Not, Want Not allowing them to spam protection spells as well as interrupt
====Recommended skills====
*Frozen Soil, as most of the Stone Summit have a resurrection skill.
*Anti-knock down, there are large mobs of Modniir on the path to Justiciar Thommis.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
司法官 湯米茲是地圖最左側的 Boss。
優先攻擊 Stone Summit Warders；他們有防護結界，並能造成大量範圍傷害。
另一個主要目標是 Stone Summit Defenders。他們藉由強力吸收與 Waste Not, Want Not 反覆施放防護法術，並中斷隊伍的行動。
====推薦技能====
* 凍土：大多數石峰矮人都有復活技能。
* 防止擊倒的技能：通往司法官 湯米茲的路上有大群 Modniir。

完成記錄歸屬接取任務時的輪換期，不會改變永久技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: spam 指反覆施放法術，不是傳送垃圾郵件；wards 為結界，保留優先目標與防擊倒建議。 完成記錄僅屬接取時輪換期，不變更永久技能與清圖記錄。

entries.source:
Mungri is located close to the Aspenwood Gate (Kurzick) entrance to Ferndale. Note that the area is swarming with Dredge patrols, so advance carefully and pull each group to avoid over aggroing. He is a powerful healer and often has a Dredge Gardener in his mob. Interrupts, skills that punish healing or enchantments are recommended due to the boss's reliance on Life Bond and other enchantments.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
Mungri 位於 Aspenwood Gate（庫茲柯）通往蕨谷的入口附近。該區有大量挖掘者巡邏隊，應小心前進，逐群引開，避免同時引到過多敵人。他的治療能力很強，所在敵群中常有一名 Dredge Gardener。由於此 Boss 仰賴生命連結與其他加持，建議攜帶中斷技能，或能針對治療、加持施加懲罰的技能。

entries.source:
There are several patrols along the way a few can be avoided, watch out for overlapping patrols. Commander Wahli is surrounded by a huge mob, be prepared to retreat if overwhelmed especially in hard mode. If you resurrect, be careful as another group (including a Corsair boss) patrols very near the closest resurrection shrine to Wahli.

Of the three routes shown on the map to the right, the blue path has some easily avoidable Heket groups and later a few plant and elemental groups. The red path avoids most of the Corsair bosses, but does include a significant number of elemental foes. The Corsair bosses patrol fairly close together on the yellow path, but can be carefully pulled apart.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
沿路有數支巡邏隊，其中幾支可以避開；留意巡邏路線交疊的位置。指揮官 瓦里身旁有大量敵人，若難以應付就準備撤退，困難模式尤其如此。若在復活神殿復活，要留意另一支巡邏隊（包含一名海盜 Boss），其路線非常接近距離瓦里最近的復活神殿。

右側地圖的三條路線中，藍線沿途有容易避開的青蛙族群敵群，後段還有幾群植物與元素生物。紅線避開大多數海盜 Boss，但包含不少元素敵人。黃線上的海盜 Boss 巡邏位置相近，可以小心地逐一引開。

entries.source:
As you approach his location, spread out the party, using flags for heroes and henchmen; Rocktail's siege attack can easily wipe an entire party. That same spike also makes the boss vulnerable to damage reflection skills, especially Pain Inverter. 

* A group of Charr appears near the devourer's location; you can pull Rocktail away or just wait for the patrol to move away.
* You can use the nearby Siege Devourer to tank against both the Charr party and Rocktail.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
接近 Rocktail 時，用旗幟分散英雄與傭兵的位置；其攻城攻擊很容易使整支隊伍全滅。同樣的爆發傷害也使此 Boss 容易受到傷害反射技能反制，尤其是 Pain Inverter。

* 這隻吞噬者附近會出現一群夏爾；可以將 Rocktail 引離，或等待巡邏隊離開。
* 可以使用附近的 Siege Devourer，同時承受夏爾敵群與 Rocktail 的攻擊。

entries.source:
Exit from the Marketplace into Bukdek Byway and then enter Xaquang Skyway or exit from Senji's Corner and head north. See maps for directions. The route from the Marketplace to Ghial is faster as your party will encounter fewer foes than the route from Senji's Corner; however, Senji's Corner has a wider selection of henchmen.

Ghial relies on his Flesh Golem for offense and self healing as it leaves an exploitable corpse. Consider bringing an exploit skill to prevent Ghial from reusing the corpse.

The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
entries.text:
從市集進入巴德克小徑，再前往夏安便道；也可以從山吉之街出發向北走。方向請見地圖。從市集前往 Ghial 的路線較快，遇到的敵人較少；但山吉之街可供選擇的傭兵較多。

Ghial 依賴血肉高崙（Flesh Golem）進攻與自我治療，因為高崙死亡後會留下可利用的屍體。可考慮攜帶利用屍體的技能，阻止 Ghial 再次利用同一具屍體。

完成記錄歸屬接取任務時的輪換期，不會改變永久技能或清圖進度。
entries.reason: exploit skill 在此指利用屍體的技能，不是漏洞技能；保留兩個出發據點在路線與傭兵選擇上的差別。 完成記錄僅屬接取時輪換期，不變更永久技能與清圖記錄。 固定中文舊模板稱鮮血高崙，較新操縱血肉高崙頁17494@28188在描述中明示血肉高崙；採較新描述並保留英文身份。

See the "Notes" sections of Verata the Necromancer and Kessex Peak.
* Verata does not always spawn if The Villainy of Galrath or its hard mode counterpart are active.
The completion record belongs to the rotation in which the quest was accepted. It does not change permanent skill or vanquishing progress.
